description: Schema for supervised extra personality traits in [0,1] used by ml_personality_pipeline

confidence_score.definition: Perceived self-assurance and composure in communication

professionalism_score.definition: Perceived professional demeanor, etiquette, and presentation

communication_score.definition: Perceived clarity, expressiveness, and engagement in communication

leadership_potential.definition: Perceived ability to guide, influence, and coordinate others

normalization: Scores should be continuous in [0,1]. Use at least 3 independent human raters and average.
